purpose: Assess checkpoints from user-proposed repositories against the organizer's AP DXA quality-control task

repository_decisions.task_fit: DXA spine shape research only; no validated mapping to organizer QC types
expects a segmented 3D pelvic or femoral volume
lateral DXA VFA and radiographs for fracture/osteoporosis risk, not AP DXA positioning QC
ordinary spine radiographs and segmentation, not validated for DXA
CT/MR volume segmentation, not planar DXA
chest radiograph classifiers with unrelated outputs

dxa_to_3d_cpu_benchmark.input: 12 organizer lumbar DICOM from 12 distinct study keys; six reference QC class 0 and six class 1
dxa_to_3d_cpu_benchmark.sampling: first six distinct-study images per class in image_labels.csv order
dxa_to_3d_cpu_benchmark.preprocessing: competition read_dxa normalized pixels and image_tensor(224) letterbox/ImageNet normalization; upstream inference.py/utils.py describes 512 grayscale resize plus CLAHE and is inconsistent with this checkpoint's three-channel architecture, so training preprocessing is unresolved
dxa_to_3d_cpu_benchmark.runtime: CPU, four PyTorch threads, torch.inference_mode, model loaded once
dxa_to_3d_cpu_benchmark.reason_accuracy_unavailable: The checkpoint emits an uninterpreted shape vector. Organizer labels are QC classes and criteria, without paired 3D curves or validated output-coordinate mapping.

selection_rule: Retain only checkpoints relevant to organizer AP DXA; research weights stay outside the competition verdict until output semantics and accuracy are validated.
